summary: BP p.l.c. furnished a Form 6-K disclosing the completed sale of a 5% stake in Norwegian producer Aker BP at NOK 311 per share, raising gross proceeds of about NOK 9.83 billion (~$1.06 billion). Post-sale, BP holds 68.7 million shares, roughly 10.9%, down from 15.9%. Proceeds target balance-sheet strengthening; full-year 2026 divestment proceeds now guided to ~$9 billion, ~$1 billion above prior guidance. Barclays was sole global coordinator and bookrunner; DNB Carnegie co-bookrunner. A 90-day lock-up applies to remaining shares, capping near-term overhang relief. Watch block-trade pricing versus market and any further selldown.
